connect.label: Your Sleeper username, or a league link
connect.where: Your username is the name you sign in to Sleeper with, not your team's name. A league's link is in the address bar of the league's page on sleeper.com: the long number after /leagues/ is the league id.

scoring.label: Scoring
scoring.words: the league's own scoring settings; a setting not priced here is listed on the league card

roster_slots.label: Lineup slots
roster_slots.words: every offensive slot, superflex included; IDP slots are left out and said so

matchups.label: Matchups
matchups.words: this week's opponent and every played week's points, in the league's scoring

players.label: Players
players.words: Sleeper's player directory, matched to nflverse ids for the projections

waivers.label: Waivers
waivers.words: free agents, and the claim type and time from the league's settings

transactions.label: Transactions
transactions.words: adds, drops and trades, from Sleeper's transactions

team_assets.label: Team assets
team_assets.words: team defenses are players; draft picks and waiver budgets are not read for a league opened on demand

news.label: News
news.words: ESPN's player news (most items RotoWire's), by player — the same on every platform

connect.label: Your MFL league link, id or name
connect.where: Open your league on the MFL website: the number after /home/ in the address is the league id (70587 in the example). In the MFL app, type the league's name as the app shows it.

scoring.label: Scoring
scoring.words: MFL's rules read into the projections' scoring; any piece estimated or not priced is listed on the league card

roster_slots.label: Lineup slots
roster_slots.words: starter ranges (2–4 WR) read as the minimum plus FLEX; IDP spots are left out and said so

matchups.label: Matchups
matchups.words: the schedule, each week's opponent and every played week's points; this week's live points from MFL's live scoring (a game in progress counts as its full range)

players.label: Players
players.words: MFL ids matched to Sleeper's; a player with no match is listed by name and not valued

waivers.label: Waivers
waivers.words: free agents are the players no team rosters; MFL's waiver type, waiver order and blind-bid balances are read; MFL does not share the claim time

transactions.label: Transactions
transactions.words: adds, drops, trades and waiver claims from MFL's transactions export

team_assets.label: Team assets
team_assets.words: team QBs, kickers and defenses are priced as players; draft picks and blind-bid budgets are not read

news.label: News
news.words: ESPN's player news (most items RotoWire's), by player — the same on every platform

providers.name: ESPN

connect.label: Your ESPN league link or id
connect.where: Open your league on fantasy.espn.com: the number after leagueId= in the address is the league id (4242 in the example). A public league works by its id alone; ESPN has no sign-in for other apps.

scoring.label: Scoring
scoring.words: ESPN's scoring items read into the projections' scoring; any item not priced is listed on the league card

roster_slots.label: Lineup slots
roster_slots.words: ESPN's lineup slots read as ours (OP as superflex, D/ST as DEF); IDP slots are left out and said so

matchups.label: Matchups
matchups.words: the schedule and each week's points from ESPN's matchups

players.label: Players
players.words: ESPN ids matched to Sleeper's through nflverse's id table; a player with no match is listed by name and not valued

waivers.label: Waivers
waivers.words: free agents are the players no team rosters; ESPN's waiver order and budget are not read

transactions.label: Transactions
transactions.words: adds, drops and trades from ESPN's transactions

team_assets.label: Team assets
team_assets.words: D/ST as team defenses; draft picks and waiver budgets are not read

news.label: News
news.words: ESPN's player news (most items RotoWire's), by player — the same on every platform, for the players matched to our ids

providers.note: Unofficial: ESPN has no public API for fantasy leagues. isuckatfantasy reads what a public league shows anyone, read-only.

providers.name: Yahoo

connect.label: Connect with Yahoo
connect.where: Connect with Yahoo: Yahoo asks you to allow read-only access to your fantasy leagues, then your leagues are listed here to pick from. A league's link (the number after /f1/) works too once you are connected.

scoring.label: Scoring
scoring.words: Yahoo's stat modifiers read into the projections' scoring; any stat not priced is listed on the league card

roster_slots.label: Lineup slots
roster_slots.words: Yahoo's positions read as ours (W/R/T as FLEX, Q/W/R/T as superflex); IDP slots are left out and said so

matchups.label: Matchups
matchups.words: each week's opponent and points from Yahoo's scoreboard

players.label: Players
players.words: Yahoo ids matched to Sleeper's through nflverse's id table; a player with no match is listed by name and not valued

waivers.label: Waivers
waivers.words: free agents from Yahoo's player list; waiver priority and budgets are not read

transactions.label: Transactions
transactions.words: adds, drops and trades from Yahoo's transactions

team_assets.label: Team assets
team_assets.words: DEF as team defenses; draft picks and waiver budgets are not read

news.label: News
news.words: ESPN's player news (most items RotoWire's), by player — the same on every platform, for the players matched to our ids

providers.note: Through Yahoo's official Fantasy Sports API, read-only, after you allow it with your Yahoo sign-in.
